description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Add or update products a CloudSite sells (GearHost Store). Prices are kept by GearHost, not in the page, so visitors cannot change what they pay. Each product: name, price (e.g. 12.5 for 12.50), optional id (used in the Buy button; made from the name if omitted), currency (default the store's), description, shipping (true = ask for a shipping address), active (false = hidden). Returns the products and ready-to-paste Buy button HTML (plain forms posting to https://octane.gearhost.com/checkout/) to put on the site with publish_to_my_site. Works before Stripe is connected; buttons start working once set_up_store is finished. Returns structuredContent { status, site, products:[{id,name,price,currency,shipping,active}], buy_buttons_html, payments_ready }.
name: save_products
title: Save store products
